$comment: Device-storage inventory (add-privacy-and-compliance, spec legal-pages 'Device-storage inventory'). Single source for the table on /cookies. Enforced by verify-build (no storage API in any shipped bundle unless listed under 'apis') and by e2e/specs/08-legal.spec.ts (per-route sweep). Audit 2026-10-03: no source file or bundled dependency in the shipped build references document.cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, caches, serviceWorker, cookieStore or navigator.storage.

thirdParty.note: Cloudflare states the beacon uses no cookies or localStorage. It runs only on the landing page, only when enabled, and never when GPC or Do Not Track is on.
